"''The rebel fleet?''"
"''Not an entire fleet, a couple fighters, but my men and I took care of them.''"
"''If they return, be sure to contact us.|Fenn Rau and the Imperial officer|}} In the third [[Standard year|year]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''officer''' of the [[Galactic Empire]] liaised with [[Fenn Rau]], the leader of the [[Journeyman Protector|Protectors]] of [[Concord Dawn]], on the [[third moon of Concord Dawn]]. He delivered [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to Rau and his [[Mandalorian]] warriors in exchange for their loyalty to the Empire. Rau informed the officer that the Protectors encountered [[Phoenix Cell]], and the officer told him to report any such incidents to the Empire in the future. ==Behind the scenes== This Imperial officer appeared in "[[The Protector of Concord Dawn]]," an episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.
